tables.name: District Crime Degree
tables.description: A district's own crime degree: the city's general crime moved by its District Crime steps, stopping at the best or worst. Urban encounters in the district use its modifier instead of the city's. Set, never rolled.

results.name: Dangerous
results.description: (+5 to urban encounter rolls in this district)

results.name: Frequent
results.description: (+4 to urban encounter rolls in this district)

results.name: Common
results.description: (+3 to urban encounter rolls in this district)

results.name: Uncommon
results.description: (+2 to urban encounter rolls in this district)

results.name: Infrequent
results.description: (+1 to urban encounter rolls in this district)
